Already had 3 people tell me they love my new copy button at the bottom of my posts. Makes sharing the URL so much easier, especially on mobile devices, they said. I chose to *not* have share buttons because a clipboard is universal, works on every device, and in any app. Unless the app developer is a dick.

But this is thanks to @inherentlee@flipping.rocks so go hire Lee or give Lee money!
